records.method: FactSet bottom-up S&P 500 index annual earnings-growth estimates, explicitly labelled CY. Calendar-year growth is a scenario input alongside separately dated forward-12-month P/E.
limitations: Not a guaranteed return or real-time quote. No 2028 forecast verified. Actual and estimate definitions must retain FactSet basis.
records.refreshNotes: Discover newest dated earnings-season article, then find its dated Earnings Insight PDF. The article alone gives CY2026 but this edition does not include CY2027. Never assume the quarterly growth paragraph is annual.

records.asOfBasis: publication-date; underlying consensus observation not separately given
records.method: UBS-published Nasdaq-100 consensus annual earnings growth. This year and next year refer to the article publication year. The article does not specify its consensus vendor, a separate underlying observation date, currency or per-share aggregation method.
limitations: No separate underlying data date or consensus vendor is stated in the article. No 2028 forecast verified. Preserve annual earnings wording rather than claiming a specified per-share methodology.
records.refreshNotes: Robots publishes root sitemap, which links this English sitemap. Normal GET 200; 206 daily 2026 article URLs. Parse exact daily path and DDMMYYYY or DDMMYY filename dates only for ordering, then verify article publication date and full annual pair. Newest 11 Oct8-22 articles contained no replacement pair. Public ActivityStream POST works but /bin/ is robots-disallowed; do not use as scheduled crawler route.

records.method: First Eagle publishes exact Russell 2000 annual earnings forecasts from LSEG I/B/E/S. Observation date is the explicit underlying data date, which may precede publication. Per-share aggregation and currency conventions are not specified.
limitations: Older July snapshot; must not be labelled an October consensus update. No 2028 forecast verified. Not identical to constituent-average growth figures published by Royce.

records.refreshNotes: Discover newest Small Cap Market Overview and its Download PDF link. October 12 US Small Caps in Focus is a video and provides no annual forecasts in its text. Preserve source data date independently of page publication date.

records.method: National Bank Investments CIO annual earnings-growth chart, exact Canada (S&P/TSX) series, underlying Refinitiv. Report date is used because no distinct chart observation date is printed. Earnings aggregation, currency and fiscal/calendar conventions are not explicitly specified.
limitations: Do not replace S&P/TSX with MSCI Canada. No 2028 forecast verified. Do not claim an explicit per-share basis absent a methodology definition.
